title: Doodh Ka Karz
desc: A snake charmer is falsely accused of theft by the landlords and beaten to death. His wife, Parvati, raises her son, Suraj, who, along with the loyal snake, sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Mera Pati Sirf Mera Hai
desc: Roopa does not get along with Prakash, her husband, and suspects he is having an affair. Things take a turn when she starts spreading vile rumours about Sharda, a woman living next door.

title: Preetam
desc: Raised by his aunt and uncle, orphaned Preetam grows up to become a man who cares for others; Preetam and Anil grow up like brothers, but dark undercurrents of a messy past threaten to destroy the solace and peace Preetam has in his present.

title: Badi Bahen
desc: Jyoti, a girl found by the riverbank, is adopted by a gardener who works for a wealthy family. Years later, she finally finds her true identity amidst love, deceit and twists of fate.
